mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO bookmarks (user_id, post_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId})
mapper.select: SELECT b.bookmark_id AS bookmarkId, p.post_id AS postId, p.posted_at AS postedAt, u.user_id AS postUserId, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, u.user_icon AS userIcon, s.track_name AS trackName, s.artist_name AS artistName, s.artwork_url AS artworkUrl, s.preview_url AS previewUrl, s.apple_music_url AS appleMusicUrl, m.tag_name AS tagName FROM bookmarks b JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = b.post_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN songs s ON s.song_id = p.song_id JOIN mood_tags m ON m.mood_tag_id = p.mood_tag_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND ( p.user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM friends f WHERE f.friend_status = 1 AND ( (f.requester_id = #{userId} AND f.receiver_id = p.user_id) OR (f.receiver_id = #{userId} AND f.requester_id = p.user_id) ) ) ) ORDER BY b.bookmark_id DESC
